description: This file implements the 'git merge-file' command, which performs a merge operation on three files (file1, origin, file2) using various merge strategies and diff algorithms. It handles command-line options, reads file contents, and outputs either merged content or object IDs, with support for custom labels and conflict resolution strategies.
